candidate_evidence.quote: This phase II MATCH treatment trial tests how well nivolumab and BMS-986016 (relatlimab) works in treating patients with cancer that has certain genetic changes called LAG-3 mutations with mismatch repair deficiency.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive nivolumab IV over 30 minutes on day 1 and BMS-986016 (relatlimab) over 30 minutes on day 1 of each cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as nivolumab and BMS-986016 (relatlimab), may help the body's immune system attack the cancer, and may interfere with the ability of cancer cells to grow and spread.

coder_notes: NCI-MATCH subprotocol Z1M for advanced refractory solid tumours, lymphoma and myeloma. Glioblastoma is mentioned only in the outcome descriptions (RANO criteria for glioblastoma patients), not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, so per C7/D27B coded not_glioblastoma (basket flag set true to describe the multi-cancer design). LAG-3 expression >= 1% (anti-LAG-3 relatlimab) and MMR deficiency (anti-PD-1 nivolumab) are entry requirements and mechanistically linked to the candidates. Prior PD-1/PD-L1 therapy with progression is required (treatment history). The LAG-3 quote reproduces the record text including its escape backslash.
